fields.label: Shown As
fields.description: How the status is shown, e.g. Waiting, Preparing, Ready

fields.label: Action
fields.description: Button that leads to this status, e.g. Send, Start, Complete, Deliver. Production centers show the current status and, on the button, the action of the next one.

fields.label: Waiter Can Edit
fields.description: Items in this status still belong to the waiter: they can be edited or removed and go to the production centers with the next Send. Production flows can't use these statuses. Pending (new items) always allows it; Sent never does.

fields.label: Marks
fields.description: Ready: the kitchen is done with the item (stations that wait for the whole order start from here). Finished: it reached the guest (served or delivered).

fields.label: Ask who delivers
fields.description: Moving an order into this status asks for the driver (for example "On the way").
